title: Best Costway Dehumidifier (2026): 24 to 100-Pint Reviewed
dek: Costway sells a lot of dehumidifier for not much money. Here's which size to buy, and what the thin reliability record does and doesn't tell you.
description: The best Costway dehumidifiers, from the popular Costway 32-pint to the Alexa-ready 100-pint, with reviews, recall checks, manuals and warranty explained.
intro: The **Costway 32-pint dehumidifier** is the model most shoppers land on, and for good reason: it's the brand's most-reviewed unit and sized right for a bedroom, office or small apartment. But Costway also sells 24-, 60- and 100-pint models, and picking the right one comes down to the size and dampness of your space.

It helps to know what kind of company you're buying from. Costway isn't an HVAC specialist; it's a California-based online importer, founded in 2008 in Ningbo, China, as GoPlus and renamed in 2016, that sells everything from patio furniture to pet gear alongside its dehumidifiers. That affects how its products are sold, how model numbers work, and how much reliability data exists.
We compared Costway's current lineup using the brand's published specs, retailer listings, owner reviews, Consumer Reports' brand standing and CPSC recall records. Here's what to buy.
topPicksLead: The **Costway 32-Pint** is the best Costway dehumidifier for most rooms: it's the brand's most-reviewed model and covers a bedroom or home office comfortably.

products.name: Costway 32-Pint Dehumidifier (2,000 Sq. Ft.)
pros: Owners frequently mention quiet running for its size
Three modes, two fan speeds and a 24-hour timer
products.whyWeLoveIt: It's the sweet spot of the lineup: big enough for a damp bedroom or office, small enough to tuck beside a desk, and backed by more owner feedback than any other Costway model. The console version holds a 4.3 out of 5 average on Wayfair.
products.performance: Costway rates it at 32 pints a day for up to 2,000 square feet. That coverage claim is generous for a unit this size, so we'd treat it as a strong one-room machine rather than a whole-floor solution. The LED touch panel, timer and child lock cover the basics well. For other compact options across brands, see our [best small dehumidifier](/best/best-small-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Costway 24-Pint Dehumidifier (F1W-10N014-AU1)
pros: Same core controls as the larger models
Compact for a bedroom or office
cons: Price often overlaps with the 32-pint during sales
products.whyWeLoveIt: If you only need to take the edge off a single small room, the 24-pint is the least expensive way into the lineup and one of the cheapest 24-pint units from any brand.
products.performance: Costway rates it for up to 1,500 square feet, but in practice it's a single-room machine for a bedroom, home office or closet-adjacent space. Promotions swing its price enough that the 32-pint is sometimes the better deal, so compare both before you check out. Our [best budget dehumidifier](/best/best-budget-dehumidifier/) guide covers low-cost picks from other brands.

products.name: Costway 60-Pint Dehumidifier (COST00686 / F1W-10N-10N5U1-IT)
pros: About 80% of Home Depot reviewers recommend it

products.whyWeLoveIt: For a full basement, the 60-pint gives you real extraction plus the two features a below-grade space needs most: a hose connection so you're not emptying a bucket daily, and auto-defrost for chilly floors.
products.performance: Costway rates it for up to 4,000 square feet, which covers most full basements without moving up to the 100-pint. Its three-color digital display makes it easy to read the room's humidity at a glance. Owner reviews are mixed but mostly positive, with about four in five Home Depot reviewers recommending it. See how it compares with other brands in our [best dehumidifier for basement](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-basement/) roundup.

products.whyWeLoveIt: It's the only Costway with smart controls, and it's the biggest the brand sells. For a large or unfinished basement, being able to check and adjust humidity from your phone saves a lot of trips down the stairs.
products.performance: Costway rates it at 100 pints a day for up to 5,500 square feet, with four modes and two fan speeds. It pairs with the Smart Life app over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and works with Alexa. Keep in mind that a portable unit this large still won't match a professional crawl-space or whole-house machine for durability; our [best commercial dehumidifier](/best/best-commercial-dehumidifier/) guide covers those.

blocks.text: We don't run a test lab. We compared Costway's published capacities, coverage and features against retailer listings, read owner reviews at Home Depot, Best Buy and Wayfair for recurring complaints, checked Consumer Reports' brand standing and searched CPSC records for recalls.

Because Costway's coverage claims are more generous than those from established appliance brands, we sized our recommendations conservatively and leaned on review volume and consistency as a stand-in for the long-term reliability data that doesn't exist yet.

sections.heading: What to look for in a Costway dehumidifier

items.label: Size by room, then size up
items.text: Budget brands tend to quote optimistic coverage. Use our [dehumidifier size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/) and pick the next size up if the space smells musty.

items.label: Match specs, not model numbers
items.text: The same unit carries different IDs at Home Depot, Best Buy, Amazon and Walmart. Compare pint rating and features when price-shopping.

items.label: Drainage you can live with
items.text: No current Costway has a pump. For a basement without a floor drain, look at our [best dehumidifier with pump](/best/best-dehumidifier-with-pump/) picks.

items.label: Auto-defrost for basements
items.text: If the room drops below the mid-60s, choose the 60- or 100-pint models, which handle frost on the coils.

items.label: A realistic warranty view
items.text: One year is short. Keep your receipt and register the unit so a first-year failure is easy to claim.

sections.heading: Costway dehumidifier reviews: what the evidence says

blocks.text: The honest summary is "unproven, not unreliable." Consumer Reports lists Costway as having insufficient data to rank, meaning too few members have reported owning one to produce a reliability or satisfaction score. The one Costway model CR has rated in depth, the ES10260US-WH, scored fair overall — a real but middling result for that specific unit.

On the plus side, we found no CPSC recall tied to the Costway name, while the large multi-brand dehumidifier recalls of the past decade swept up names like Keystone, GE, Frigidaire and Danby. Retailer reviews are generally positive, with quiet operation a common compliment on the 32-pint and occasional complaints about early failures across the line.

Costway sells the same designs through many retailers under channel-specific codes. The 100-pint unit is F1W-10N-10N6U1-IT at Home Depot and COST00687 at Best Buy, and other stores use their own IDs. That's normal for a general-merchandise importer, but it means you should compare by capacity and features, not by model code.

items: **Manual:** Costway posts product manuals on individual product pages on its website, and retailer listings often include a PDF. Search using the model code from the label on your unit.
**Filter:** Like most compressor dehumidifiers, Costway models use a washable mesh filter. Rinse it every couple of weeks of heavy use and let it dry fully before reinstalling.
**Warranty claims:** Contact Costway customer service with your order number and photos of the problem. Units bought through third-party sellers may need to go through that retailer first.

**Not collecting water?** Check the filter, room temperature and tank seating before assuming a fault. Our [dehumidifier not collecting water](/guides/dehumidifier-not-collecting-water/) guide covers the rest.

blocks.text: The **Costway 32-Pint** is the best Costway dehumidifier for most people: it's the most-reviewed model and right-sized for a bedroom or office. The **24-Pint** saves a little for a small room, the **60-Pint** is the basement pick with a hose connection and auto-defrost, and the **100-Pint** adds app and Alexa control for big spaces. Just go in knowing the trade-off: no recalls on record, but a one-year warranty and little long-term reliability data. If that gives you pause, compare established names in our [best dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) guide.

faqs.q: What is the best Costway dehumidifier?
faqs.a: For most bedrooms and home offices, the Costway 32-Pint. It's the brand's most-reviewed model. For a basement, step up to the 60-Pint with its hose connection and auto-defrost, or the 100-Pint with app and Alexa control for large spaces.

faqs.q: Is the Costway 32-pint dehumidifier any good?
faqs.a: For a single room, yes. Owners often praise how quiet it is, and the console version averages 4.3 out of 5 on Wayfair. Treat Costway's 2,000 sq ft coverage claim as optimistic and use it for one room rather than a whole floor.

faqs.q: Is Costway a reliable dehumidifier brand?
faqs.a: It's unproven rather than unreliable. Consumer Reports says it has insufficient data to rank the brand, and the one model CR rated in depth scored fair. We found no CPSC recall tied to Costway dehumidifiers.

Costway.Com, Inc., based in Fontana, California. The company started in Ningbo, China, in 2008 as GoPlus and rebranded in 2016. It's a general online importer that also sells furniture, toys, tools and pet supplies under brands like Gymax and Tangkula.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Costway dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Check the product page on Costway's website or the retailer listing where you bought it; many include a downloadable PDF. Use the model code on your unit's label, since the same design can carry different codes at different stores.

faqs.q: How long is the Costway dehumidifier warranty?
faqs.a: One year across the current lineup. That's shorter than some competitors, so keep your receipt and order number handy in case something fails early.

faqs.q: Can a Costway portable air conditioner replace a dehumidifier?
faqs.a: Costway's 8,000 BTU portable ACs include a dehumidify function, but they're designed to cool and must vent outside. In a cool, damp basement, a dedicated dehumidifier works much better. Our [dehumidifier vs. air conditioner](/guides/dehumidifier-vs-air-conditioner/) guide explains why.
